description: Guarded native command batching scheduling experiment and supporting after-nine/device comparisons. The native archive contains instrumented source, build and panel scripts; individual source hashes and archive hashes appear in its accompanying manifest. Corresponding result JSONs contain in-run source and binary hashes.
limitations: These instrumented experiments are comparative research outputs, not the final uninstrumented benchmark.
Extension binaries were intentionally omitted; historical source and binary hashes are recorded in result files.
The device sketch-4 weighted seed 41 nonconvergence existed under both compared schedules and is preserved in raw results.
